plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Three gaps. (1) C10 needs trace of a call on each sending call. That instrument is only available on named lines during the work at 10 per line, so 100 lines cost 1000 and the allowance of 50 covers only 5. Nothing in the plan shows that each confirmed send left a row in the outbox. (2) C5 needs scope of a call on each of the 101 reads. That is only available on named lines during the work, at 10 per line, and the allowance covers 5 lines, so the read scope is sampled at most. (3) C3 has no instrument: the library has no check of each case's category against the requester's rule, and the summary of the change counts only rows holding a value the agreement fixes, which the agreement does not fix for category. I would have wanted a per-customer category check and an outbox trace at A3 for all sends. Within the 200 ceiling I have spent 180, leaving 20 unused, which is not enough for any of these.
